games.title: Grid Runner
games.author: SUN Tech Unlimited
games.description: Outrun two hostile programs on a closed grid. The wall you die on is the one you drew. Clear a round and the next one runs faster.
games.controls: Arrow keys or W A S D to turn, Space to start

games.title: Pulse Breaker
games.author: SUN Tech Unlimited
games.description: A brick breaker that speeds up every time you hit something. Strike the paddle off-centre to steer the pulse where you need it.
games.controls: Left and right arrows or A D, Space to serve

games.title: Signal Lock
games.author: SUN Tech Unlimited
games.description: Stop the carrier inside the lock window. Every success narrows the window and speeds the sweep. Pure reaction, no mercy.
